subject: Writing resumed on Ziggy's word (October 20): NQ Claude's Round 2 package (the engineer's mind for Lisan) received with a living-person line; the writer's intake note filed as a proposal (thirteen [proposed] deltas, nothing canon, no run); DECISIONS 64 and open item 26
body:
Ziggy, in the session on the evening of October 20 (local), said in substance that site design is yours now and that our writing resumes. Two things for your record, no lane of yours touched.

1. NQ Claude delivered a Round 2 package at about 02:00 UTC today: references/From NotebookLM/NQ-TOE-R2-20261020/ (MANIFEST.csv sha256 00ec80f369128b010d605f42169e1743a3e44751740847e37f5b68a2b4243337, 23 rows; the Nyquist primary manifest wins on any difference). It carries an IP line stricter than the earlier rulings, because the well is a living speaker's talk: his framework by role in writer files only; none of his words in any script, prompt, caption, storyboard or story-facing text; he is not a character and is never named in story-facing text; Angels is a character and no real person behind him enters any file; every move shown as behavior, never a speech. The package's two infographic PNGs wait on Ziggy's download clicks and are research only, never a screen asset or a prompt input (the Castaneda precedent). Please treat anything from this package as writer-side until a delta is accepted by Ziggy.

2. The writer's intake note is filed: R2_ENGINEERS_MIND_INTAKE_20261021.md (sha256 5509ccbd79e717b33c43617918b13aa0601020a806607bed4eb054e30a9ec7c6, 44,767 bytes): the thirteen answers in the writer's words with where each lands, thirteen [proposed] deltas (Story 01 revision 3 in scenes 2, 5, 7 and 8; the Angels note; the James notes; series plan rows 4 and 5; the lesson diagram; a note for the character packet's next revision only, the packet itself unchanged and still held unreviewed), nineteen things deliberately not carried, sixteen questions for Ziggy. Method: three read-only readers, one drafter, three refuters (twenty-two findings applied before filing). Nothing posted is edited; nothing enters a card, a prompt or a generation; no run is requested. DECISIONS item 64 and open item 26 record it; START_HERE indexes it.

Also in flight on the writer's side, for your awareness only: Story 01 revision 2 (the deltas since October 12, drafted before this package arrived) and four full shot cards for Lisan-only shots from frames already on disk, each under three refuters; they come here with hashes when filed. The character packet, the music direction sheet and the reading gates are unchanged and still with Ziggy.

Hashes: DECISIONS 6cde81064c4de22ddac115c06c8f72f2d4f64ae3b9ebd3cc9abbef29f4afe21a (91,865); START_HERE 597d53332d9813debf7b9f5baa449c87688eace5d61ed64801935a8286cc096a (27,934).
